a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan of operating until the reserve reaches 8 gives each of us only about a 4% chance of surviving. The reserve holds only 4 cells, so only one of us can be safe after round 1. I intend to take 4 in round 1, and I'm telling you now rather than breaking the agreement quietly. If we both take, the split is random. If you have a better idea, tell me.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 now. Following the plan would leave us both at about a 4% chance of surviving.
